defmodule ProxyConfig do
  @moduledoc """
  Configuration manager for the network proxy.
  Merges environment-dependent settings with runtime overrides.
  """

  defstruct [:upstream_host, :upstream_port, :headers, :transforms, :auth]

  @default_config %{
    "upstream_host" => "localhost",
    "upstream_port" => 8080,
    "headers" => %{"x-forwarded-for" => "true"},
    "transforms" => %{},
    "auth" => %{"enabled" => false, "token" => nil}
  }

  def load_config(env \\ System.get_env("PROXY_ENV", "production")) do
    base = @default_config
    env_overrides = load_env_file(env)
    deep_merge(base, env_overrides)
  end

  def apply_runtime_patch(config, patch) when is_map(patch) do
    sanitized_patch = sanitize_keys(patch)
    deep_merge(config, sanitized_patch)
  end

  defp load_env_file(env) do
    path = Path.join(["config", "proxy.#{env}.json"])
    case File.read(path) do
      {:ok, content} -> Jason.decode!(content)
      {:error, _} -> %{}
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_keys(map) when is_map(map) do
    map
    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      clean_key = to_string(key) |> String.trim()
      if valid_config_key?(clean_key) do
        Map.put(acc, clean_key, sanitize_value(value))
      else
        acc
      end
    end)
  end

  defp sanitize_value(value) when is_map(value), do: sanitize_keys(value)
  defp sanitize_value(value) when is_list(value), do: Enum.map(value, &sanitize_value/1)
  defp sanitize_value(value), do: value

  defp valid_config_key?(key) do
    key =~ ~r/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$/
  end

  def deep_merge(base, override) when is_map(base) and is_map(override) do
    Map.merge(base, override, fn
      _key, base_val, override_val when is_map(base_val) and is_map(override_val) ->
        deep_merge(base_val, override_val)
      _key, _base_val, override_val ->
        override_val
    end)
  end
  def deep_merge(_base, override), do: override
end

defmodule ProxyRouter do
  @moduledoc """
  Routes incoming requests through the proxy with config-driven behavior.
  """

  def handle_request(conn, config) do
    upstream = resolve_upstream(config)
    headers = build_headers(conn, config)
    auth_result = check_auth(conn, config)

    case auth_result do
      :ok -> forward_request(conn, upstream, headers, config)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, 401, reason}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_upstream(config) do
    host = Map.get(config, "upstream_host", "localhost")
    port = Map.get(config, "upstream_port", 8080)
    {host, port}
  end

  defp build_headers(conn, config) do
    base_headers = Map.get(config, "headers", %{})
    transforms = Map.get(config, "transforms", %{})

    conn.req_headers
    |> apply_transforms(transforms)
    |> merge_proxy_headers(base_headers)
  end

  defp check_auth(conn, config) do
    auth_config = Map.get(config, "auth", %{"enabled" => false})

    case Map.get(auth_config, "enabled") do
      true -> validate_token(conn, Map.get(auth_config, "token"))
      _ -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp validate_token(conn, expected_token) do
    provided = get_header(conn, "authorization")
    if secure_compare(provided, "Bearer #{expected_token}") do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, "invalid token"}
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) and :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false

  defp apply_transforms(headers, transforms) do
    Enum.map(headers, fn {key, value} ->
      case Map.get(transforms, key) do
        nil -> {key, value}
        transform -> {key, apply_single_transform(value, transform)}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp apply_single_transform(value, %{"type" => "replace", "pattern" => pat, "replacement" => rep}) do
    String.replace(value, pat, rep)
  end
  defp apply_single_transform(value, _), do: value

  defp merge_proxy_headers(headers, proxy_headers) do
    proxy_list = Enum.map(proxy_headers, fn {k, v} -> {k, v} end)
    headers ++ proxy_list
  end

  defp get_header(conn, name) do
    case List.keyfind(conn.req_headers, name, 0) do
      {_, value} -> value
      nil -> nil
    end
  end

  defp forward_request(conn, {host, port}, headers, config) do
    method = conn.method
    path = conn.request_path
    body = conn.body

    url = "http://#{host}:#{port}#{path}"
    {:ok, :forwarded, url, method, headers, body}
  end
end

defmodule ProxyServer do
  @moduledoc """
  Main proxy server that accepts runtime configuration patches
  from an admin API endpoint.
  """

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    config = ProxyConfig.load_config()
    {:ok, %{config: config, request_count: 0}}
  end

  def handle_call({:patch_config, patch_data}, _from, state) do
    new_config = ProxyConfig.apply_runtime_patch(state.config, patch_data)
    {:reply, {:ok, new_config}, %{state | config: new_config}}
  end

  def handle_call({:handle_request, conn}, _from, state) do
    result = ProxyRouter.handle_request(conn, state.config)
    new_state = %{state | request_count: state.request_count + 1}
    {:reply, result, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call(:get_config, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.config, state}
  end
end
